newsitem.title: USA: PageNet buys 25 pct of Radiotelefonia.
newsitem.headline: PageNet buys 25 pct of Radiotelefonia.

text.p: Paging Network Inc (PageNet) said on Wednesday it had bought a 25 percent interest in Spain's Sociedad de Radiotelefonia Movil S.A. (SRM).
SRM owns Compania Europea de Radiobusqueda SA (CERSA), a Spanish paging company, and PageNet said it had entered into an agreement to provide operational help to CERSA.
In addition to PageNet, SRM's shareholders are Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, several Spanish utility companies, and Mannesmann Eurokom GmBH, a unit of Germany's Mannesmann AG.
PageNet's agreement includes an option to buy another 26 percent of CERSA if Spanish foreign ownership restrictions change. PageNet then would own 51 percent of the subsidiary.

CERSA provides local and nationwide paging services and has about 25,000 units in service. Jay Knauf, former vice president and general manager of PageNet's Burbank, Calif., operation, will serve as general manager of CERSA.
